info.title: Logweir product API
info.description: The bounded shared-console product API (PLAT-17.1). Not a Kubernetes proxy: no generic resource path, no Secret, Pod, log, exec or Job access, no delete, and no arbitrary patch. Every error is application/problem+json. Unsafe methods require Content-Type: application/json and an Origin equal to the configured public origin. Durable creates require Idempotency-Key. Capabilities without a route are advertised false in /api/v1/session.

CreateRestoreRequest.description:
`POST /api/v1/namespaces/{ns}/restores`.

`planBytes` is OPAQUE: the service checks `planHash` against the SHA-256 of exactly these bytes and stores them unchanged. It never parses or re-emits the plan document.

title.description: A fixed title for the code.

ProblemCode.description:
The stable problem codes. Clients branch on `code`, never on `detail`.

The decision's baseline set is here verbatim (`unauthenticated`, `session_expired`, `forbidden`, `namespace_forbidden`, `not_found`, `idempotency_conflict`, `state_conflict`, `approval_required`, `policy_mismatch`, `precondition_failed`, `validation_failed`, `rate_limited`, `kubernetes_unavailable`, `upstream_timeout`, plus the cursor pair). The remainder name transport-level refusals the baseline did not enumerate; each is documented in the OpenAPI document.

oneOf.description: 400 — the body is not JSON, a query string is malformed or carries an unknown or repeated parameter.
400 — a header this service refuses outright (`Impersonate-*`).
400 — a durable POST arrived without `Idempotency-Key`.
400 — `Idempotency-Key` is not 8–128 visible ASCII characters, or is present on a route that does not accept it.
400 — a list cursor failed authentication or names another scope.
401 — no authenticated actor (PLAT-17.2 authenticators).
401 — the session is past its signed expiry (PLAT-17.2).
403 — the actor is not permitted this action.
403 — the namespace is not explicitly granted to the actor.
403 — an unsafe method without an `Origin` exactly equal to the configured public origin.
404 — no such route or no such object.
405 — the route exists and does not accept this method.
409 — the idempotency key was already used with a different request.
409 — the deterministic object exists but was not created by this idempotency scope; it is never adopted.
409 — an approval is required first (PLAT-19.2).
409 — the bound approval policy does not match (PLAT-19.2).
410 — the list cursor expired or Kubernetes compacted its continue token; restart the list without a cursor.
412 — `expectedResourceVersion` is not the object's current version.
413 — the request body exceeds its limit.
415 — an unsafe method without `Content-Type: application/json`.
421 — the `Host` header names an authority this listener does not serve (DNS-rebinding defence).
422 — the request is well-formed JSON and fails validation.
429 — Kubernetes throttled the request; see `Retry-After`.
500 — an invariant this service holds did not hold.
503 — Kubernetes could not be reached or refused this service's own identity.
504 — the Kubernetes call exceeded its 10-second deadline.
The last probe reached a broker.
The last probe did not.
No completed probe.

oneOf.description: A drill into a proven scratch cluster, torn down afterwards.

replayed.description: On a durable create: whether this response replays an earlier identical request (HTTP 200) rather than creating (HTTP 201).

clusterRef.description: The target connection, in this namespace.

ResultStatus.description: The operation's result, separate from evidence verification.

oneOf.description: No result yet.
Exit 0 (and, for a restore, outcome `pass` when recorded).
Exit 2: a signed result that is not a pass.
Exit 3, or a controller refusal before execution.
Exit 1 or 4, a crash, or a terminal failure without a code.
A combination this build does not recognise.

note.description: Why nothing would be removed, when that is not "nothing to remove".

removalCommands.description: Removal commands in the archive scheme's own CLI. Reported, never run.

setsThatWouldBeRemoved.description: Sets that would be removed, newest first. Nothing was deleted.

skippedManifests.description: How many manifests could not be read.

truncated.description: Whether any list above was cut at 100 entries.

RetentionRequest.description: Retention reporting settings. Logweir deletes nothing.

keepDays.description: Keep sets newer than N days.

RetentionView.description: Retention settings of a stored schedule.

keepDays.description: Keep sets newer than N days.

resourceVersion.description: The resourceVersion; send it back as `expectedResourceVersion`.

replayed.description: On a durable create: whether this response replays an earlier identical request (HTTP 200) rather than creating (HTTP 201).

ScheduleStatusView.description: What the schedule controller last recorded.

lastFireTime.description: When the schedule last created a Backup.

nextFireTime.description: When it will next create one.

pendingBackup.description: A reserved Backup name whose creation is not yet confirmed.

capabilities.description: The union of the grants' capabilities.

csrfToken.description: The CSRF token for unsafe requests; `null` in localAdmin mode, which relies on the loopback listener and the exact Origin check.

expiresAt.description: When the session expires; `null` in localAdmin mode, which has no session.

expectedResourceVersion.description: The resourceVersion the client last read. A stale value is `precondition_failed`.

suspended.description: The desired value of the schedule's one mutable field.

prefix.description: Prepended to each source topic name.

VerificationState.description: Whether the controller verified the signed evidence.

oneOf.description: Not finished, or evidence exists and no verdict is recorded yet.
The controller verified the signature and digest.
The controller verified and the answer was no.
The controller could not attempt verification. NOT a verified result.
The finished run recorded no signed evidence to verify.
A verdict string this build does not recognise.

VerifiedSubjectView.description: The exact object whose bytes the controller verified.
